testCases.label: Verify a new stack is created successfully
testCases.description: Checks that createNewStack() returns a non-null Deque instance.

testCases.label: Verify a new stack starts with size 0
testCases.description: Checks that getSize() returns 0 for a newly created stack.

testCases.label: Verify adding one item updates stack size to 1
testCases.description: Adds one item with addToTopOfStack() and verifies getSize() returns 1.

testCases.label: Verify adding two items updates stack size to 2
testCases.description: Adds two items to the stack and verifies that getSize() returns 2.

testCases.label: Verify removing top item follows LIFO and reduces size
testCases.description: Adds three items, removes one with removeFromTopOfStack(), checks returned value is the most recent item, and size becomes 2.

testCases.label: Verify two removals follow LIFO order and size updates
testCases.description: Adds three items, removes two, verifies items removed in LIFO order, and the remaining size is 1.

testCases.label: Verify peek returns top item without altering size
testCases.description: Adds three items, calls getTopOfStackWithoutRemoving(), verifies returned value is the most recent item, and size remains unchanged.
